items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Al liked the way I played and subsequently I went into all of his bands, and he booked a lot of the shows in Binghamton and I played all the time there.

ctx.x: Is there a teacher along the way that you credit with really helping you along this path?
In Binghamton, which we were talking about before, just the area itself, there was a guy named Al Hamme who ran a lot of the jazz bands up there.
Right, I was going to ask about that.
